function.name: compute_charge

function.name: compute_charge
function.description: Vellumtide billing calculator. Reads the account's tier, seats, API calls and discount from the remembered tool results itself and computes a charge in dollars; it knows the rate card.

direct.long: MemoryRouter attaches the remembered tool results (router chat --boundary) and the model works out the amount itself

copied.short: a calculator, inputs copied by the model
copied.long: the same memory, and a compute_charge tool: the model copies the inputs from memory into the tool call, code does the arithmetic

typed.long: compute_charge takes only the account and the quantity, and reads each input from the typed tool results itself (the latest result per field); a missing result is an error that names the tool
